run_launch_debugging: run the launch_debugging function to attach a Rust LLDB debugger to a Python process
test_launch_debugging: test the launch_debugging function with a valid sys.argv and existing .vscode/launch.json
review_launch_debugging: review the launch_debugging function for correct PID injection into VSCode launch.json
refactor_lldb_wait_time: refactor the LLDB_DEBUG_WAIT_TIME_SECONDS constant to be configurable at runtime
summarize_launch_debugging: summarize how launch_debugging injects the current PID into launch.json and executes a target script
